title: Gully's valentine
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully has a valentine. It's for the dog. A walrus holding a heart, on a napkin, with a maple bar taped to it. The dog eats the maple bar and the napkin. Gully considers this a success.

panels.composition: The dock. GULLY with a folded napkin and a maple bar taped to it. BARNABY already knowing. WOOD.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager on a dock holding a folded napkin with a maple bar taped to it while a small dog watches intently, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The napkin open: a walrus holding a heart, ballpoint. The bar.

image.prompt: close on a napkin with a ballpoint drawing of a walrus holding a heart, a maple bar taped beside it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog eating the bar. And the napkin. Gully watching, pleased.

image.prompt: a small dog eating a pastry and the napkin it came on while a teenager watches with satisfaction, black and white, no words
a young man on a dock, dry, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'He ate it, Woody.' The walrus with a heart: the only valentine in the run that gets answered.
